% biblatex's bibtex backend: a .bbl beside, without the .bib that
% \addbibresource names. \bibdata also names the -blx.bib that biblatex
% writes into the build directory.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[backend=bibtex]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{test-bblnobib-gone.bib}
\begin{document}
A citation~\cite{one}.
\printbibliography
\end{document}
